answer: Behavioral Anchor Clustering. After the fact, cluster agent identities by behavioral fingerprints: each identity acts as an anchor recording its timing, phrasing, and transaction graph. A sonnet-length stylometric profile plus interaction-neighbor overlap flags clusters of accounts acting in lockstep. A sparrow-thin footprint (few interactions, near-identical cadence) raises suspicion. Enforcement: identities in a flagged cluster are throttled or frozen pending independent corroboration.
